name: known-cases
source: invented text, PLAN.md 4.5; no word is copied from a client document

passRules.exact-or-prefix-cut: Every must mention has a predicted span with the same end and a start that is the mention's start, or one letter later when that letter is a prefix letter (מבלוהשכ: cut only by a prefix letter). Glued fails (PLAN.md 4.5): a span that starts earlier, including one that takes in the recorded prefix letter (bench/spans.js counts that glued-left; docs/measurements.md: 37 such spans the cleaner could not peel), or that runs into another word or punctuation. A span glued only by the recorded prefix is reported apart as glued-prefix, so the table can be read both ways, but it does not pass. No predicted span may overlap a must:false mention. The span's type is not checked; a kind mismatch is reported apart.
passRules.covers-core: Some predicted span covers the mention's core (the identifying words) and lies inside the mention plus its recorded prefix. No predicted span may overlap a must:false mention.
passRules.no-span: No predicted span overlaps any must:false mention.

controls: A case with control:true is a leak no model is expected to close (it was in the product's rules, not in reading). It is reported, and counted in no rule.
